data.body: **P2:** `useContextCarrier` is enabled whenever the global `SdkTracerProvider` is visible, but provider visibility does not prove that `DurableSampler` shares the plugin's class loader. With a direct global provider using an agent-loaded sampler, agent-side consumption clears only the property while this application-side holder remains in the processor parent, so forwarding that parent can apply durable sampling to an unrelated span. Gate the carrier on actual same-loader ownership rather than `sdkTracerProvider != null`, and extend the two-loader test to expose the direct provider instead of wrapping it.
